abundance.definition: A quantity an APB2 rule marks with the layer role abundance: what it measures, and whether the producing software normalizes it across runs.

values.intensity: A measured signal of the level's feature, summed, integrated or at apex, at the MS level the software quantifies on.
values.ms1_intensity: A measured MS1 signal, reported beside the software's fragment-based quantity.
values.maxlfq: A MaxLFQ estimate: delayed normalization and maximal peptide-ratio extraction (Cox et al. 2014).
values.ibaq: Intensity-based absolute quantification: summed intensity divided by the number of theoretically observable peptides.

normalization.definition: Whether the producing software normalizes the value across runs; which method a run used is not catalogued.

values.none: The software never normalizes this column.
values.run_setting: The column carries whatever cross-run normalization the run's settings chose, possibly none.

confidence.definition: How likely an identification, or the signal quantified for it, is correct, as the producing software reports it.

values.pep: Posterior error probability: the probability that this single identification is wrong; lower is better.
values.q_value: The smallest false discovery rate at which this identification, or quantified signal, is accepted; lower is better.
values.library_q_value: The q-value of the identification's spectral-library entry, built across all runs; lower is better.
values.global_q_value: The q-value of the identification across the whole experiment; lower is better.

values.identification: Whether the level's entity is correctly identified.
values.quantification: Whether the signal quantified for it, such as its MS1 peak, belongs to it.

proteobench_entrapment.definition: How likely an identification, or the signal quantified for it, is correct, as the producing software reports it.

values.pep: Posterior error probability: the probability that this single identification is wrong; lower is better.
values.q_value: The smallest false discovery rate at which this identification, or quantified signal, is accepted; lower is better.
values.library_q_value: The q-value of the identification's spectral-library entry, built across all runs; lower is better.
values.global_q_value: The q-value of the identification across the whole experiment; lower is better.

values.identification: Whether the level's entity is correctly identified.
values.quantification: Whether the signal quantified for it, such as its MS1 peak, belongs to it.

apb.definition: The fields APB itself writes under the same name or role for every vendor: the ProForma identifiers, the decoy and contaminant flags, the columns a rule's roles name, and the sample annotation's condition and biological replicate.

values.peptide: The plain amino-acid sequence: ProForma_peptide (PSI-MS MS:1000888, stripped peptide sequence).
values.peptidoform: The sequence with its modifications in ProForma notation: ProForma_peptidoform (PSI-MS MS:1003169, proforma peptidoform sequence).
values.peptidoform_unlocalized: The sequence with modifications whose positions the vendor does not report, as ProForma unknown-position groups: ProForma_peptidoform_unlocalized, which MaxQuant's peptidoform level writes instead of ProForma_peptidoform.
values.peptidoform_ion: The peptidoform with its charge: ProForma_ion (PSI-MS MS:1003270, proforma peptidoform ion notation).
values.peptidoform_fragment: A fragment of a peptidoform ion: ProForma_ion with the fragment label, ProForma_fragment.
values.decoy: Whether the vendor marks the feature as a decoy: apb_Decoy.
values.contaminant: Whether the vendor marks the feature as a contaminant it flags or adds itself: apb_Contaminant.
values.protein_assignment: The protein or protein group the vendor assigns the feature to: the var column the level's rule marks with the role protein_assignment.
values.fasta_accessions: The FASTA accessions the vendor lists for the feature: the var column the level's rule marks with the role fasta_accessions.
values.condition: The experimental group a sample belongs to, as MSstats' Condition.
values.bioreplicate: The biological replicate a sample comes from; one value across conditions marks a repeated subject, as MSstats' BioReplicate.

chromatography.definition: Chromatographic retention times of a feature and the bounds and widths of its elution peak, with their original unit. Measured, aligned, predicted and library values are different kinds, as run, library and global q-values are in confidence. The catalogue identifies fields; consumers perform any unit conversion.

kind.definition: Which chromatographic quantity the value is.

values.retention_time: Where the feature eluted in this run, measured on the run's own time axis: the apex or centre of its elution peak.
values.aligned_retention_time: The measured retention time, moved by the software's alignment onto a scale shared by all runs: a reference run's time axis or the library's iRT scale.
values.predicted_retention_time: Where the software expects the feature to elute in this run, from its library or prediction model calibrated to the run; not a measurement.
values.library_retention_time: The spectral library's reference retention time, the same in every run.
values.mean_apex_retention_time: A mean of apex times the software reports beside its apex retention time; what it averages over is not established.
values.ms2_retention_time: The time of the MS/MS spectrum that identified the feature, rather than the apex of its elution peak.
values.peak_start: Where the feature's elution peak begins, on the run's own time axis.
values.peak_end: Where the feature's elution peak ends, on the run's own time axis.
values.aligned_peak_start: Where the elution peak begins, on the aligned scale of aligned_retention_time.
values.aligned_peak_end: Where the elution peak ends, on the aligned scale of aligned_retention_time.
values.peak_fwhm: The width of the elution peak at half its maximum height.
values.aligned_peak_fwhm: The width at half maximum, on the aligned scale of aligned_retention_time.
values.peak_width: The full width of the elution peak, from its start to its end.

unit.definition: Time unit or scale of the retained numeric value, before any consumer conversion. Unknown means the source does not establish one unit for this field.

values.second: Seconds; multiply by 1 to express the value in QPX seconds.
values.minute: Minutes; multiply by 60 to express the value in QPX seconds.
values.irt: Indexed retention time: the dimensionless scale of the software's library or reference peptides. It is not a physical time and cannot be converted to seconds.
